title: cineraria helenitis
intro: Cineraria helenitis, commonly known as Baboon's Beard or Wild Cineraria, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cineraria helenitis include its use as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues and its application as a wound dressing to aid in healing and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
